Daniel Burman
Daniel Burman (born 29 August 1973 in Buenos Aires) is an Argentine film director, screenplay writer, and producer. According to film critic Joel Poblete, who writes for "Mabuse", a cinema magazine, Daniel Burman is one of the members of the so-called "New Argentina Cinema", which began "circa" 1998. Film critic Anthony Kaufman, writing for "indieWIRE", an online community of independent filmmakers and aficionados, said Burman's "A Chrysanthemum Burst in Cincoesquinas" (1998) has been cited as the beginning of the "New Argentine Cinema" wave.
